DISMANTLING THE PUMP SET        
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
       2. Remove set screws (16), which hold the bearing                          
                                                                                  
         cover (15) to the rear cover, pull rear cover and                        
         bearing cover apart, by which the shaft seal (10)                        
                                                                                  
         is pulled off the shaft.                                                 
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
      Ø330/415/418/465/525-12 combination                                         
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
       1. Remove set screw (6). Pull off the impeller (5),                        
         and remove sunk key (9).                                                 
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
                                                                                  
       2. Pull rear cover out of motor bracket, by which                          
                                                                                  
         the shaft seal (10) is pulled off the shaft.
